channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump has ‘run out of options’ in Iran war: Stephen Walt
item.description: Political scientist Stephen Walt says Trump promised to make US stronger, but many of his policies are making it weaker.

item.title: Iran war: Top US lawmaker says Republicans can ‘absolutely’ win midterms
item.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson, a Trump ally, admits it 'would be helpful' if conflict ends before elections in November.

item.title: Photos: Ukraine celebrates National Flag Day
item.description: People observe a minute of silence for those killed in war to mark the holiday established in 2004.

item.title: Can Nigeria cash in on Iran war?
item.description: Ekperikpe Ekpo says the US-Israel war on Iran has pushed Nigeria to expand its gas production.

item.title: Iran’s government signals fuel price hike on eve of new US sanctions
item.description: Prices for food and other items are soaring, and there is a history of unrest, so any increase is being considered.

item.title: Pezeshkian says Iran ‘has not become Venezuela’ despite war and sanctions
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian says Iran has stood firm despite what he calls a full-scale war.

item.title: Heavy Israeli air strike hits warehouse in central Gaza
item.description: Heavy Israeli air strike hits warehouse in central Gaza

item.title: France links sharp rise in drownings to heatwaves
item.description: A government minister says people have been taking risks by going into the water, with 301 deaths since 19 June.

item.title: Girl, 17, killed in Swedish sword attack, police say
item.description: Two boys aged 12 and 17 were also injured, while an 18-year-old suspect has been detained.

item.title: Syria says Israeli strike near Damascus violation of international law
item.description: The latest incident comes days after reports emerged Israel had struck a military airbase close to the Turkish border.
